title: Know When Rivals Change Prices
summary: Watch competitor product prices and get an alert when they move, then update your own prices from your real costs.

money_potential.label: Medium
money_potential.basis: Assumes you sell products that rivals also sell; the value is faster price decisions and margin you protect.
money_potential.note: Value tiers are our rough estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative value to the business, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: You react to price moves while they still matter.
Your prices come from your costs, not guesses.
who_its_for: Online shops that compete on price.
Makers who sell next to bigger brands.

stack.name: Competitor Price Alert
stack.role: Monitors competitor product prices and emails you when they change.
stack.creator: Yaron Been

stack.name: Product Price Writer
stack.role: Reads your costs from Google Sheets and suggests retail prices for each Shopify product and variant.
stack.creator: LBallz77283

steps.name: Product Price Writer
steps.does: Suggests retail prices from your costs

outputs: Suggested prices with the cost behind them

steps: List the competitor products that matter most.
Let the alert run and read each change.
Compare with your costs in the price writer.
Set your prices yourself in Shopify.
guardrails: Check each suggested price against your real costs and fees before you publish.
Use public product pages only and follow each site's terms.
